'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**Nine people are killed and five others are injured in clashes between [[FARC dissidents]] and the [[National Liberation Army (Colombia)|National Liberation Army]] (ELN) in [[Arauca Department|Arauca]], [[Colombia]]. It occurs as the ELN concludes a fourth round of [[Colombian peace process|peace talks]] with the [[Government of Colombia|government]]. [https://www.thedailystar.net/news/world/news/nine-killed-colombia-guerrillas-clash-despite-peace-talks-3411446 (AFP via ''The Daily Star'')]
*[[Internal conflict in Peru]]
**Four [[Peruvian Army|Peruvian soldiers]] and two [[Shining Path]] militants are killed in a clash in [[Huanta Province]], [[Peru]], in the early morning hours. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/9/4/six-killed-in-peru-in-clashes-between-military-and-shining-path-rebel-group (Al Jazeera)]

''' Business and economy'''
*American [[Fast-moving consumer goods|consumer packaged goods]] [[holding company]] [[Conagra Brands]] recalls over 245,000 pounds of [[Banquet Foods|Banquet]] frozen [[Chicken as food|chicken]] over concerns of [[plastic contamination]]. [https://www.foxbusiness.com/fox-news-food-drink/conagra-brands-recalls-245k-pounds-banquet-frozen-chicken-strips-meals-plastic-contamination (Fox Business)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five people are killed and three more are missing during [[flood]]s across [[Spain]]. The heaviest rains occurred in the [[coastal]] provinces of [[Cádiz]], [[Tarragona]] and [[Province of Castellón|Castellón]]. [https://www.thelocal.com/20230905/three-dead-and-three-still-missing-after-flash-floods-in-spain (The Local Europe)]

*[[Relocation of Marine Corps Air Station Futenma]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Japan]] orders [[Okinawa Prefecture|Okinawa]] to allow the [[United States Armed Forces]] to expand its [[runway]]s and military infrastructure on [[Okinawa Island|the island]] despite protests from locals opposing the American military's presence. ''' Politics and elections '''
*The [[parliament of Vanuatu]] elects [[Sato Kilman]] as the new [[Prime Minister of Vanuatu|prime minister]], replacing [[Ishmael Kalsakau]]. Vanuatu entered a [[political crisis]] after opposition parties lodged a [[no-confidence]] petition criticizing then Kalsakau for signing a security pact with [[Australia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/vanuatu-parliament-elect-new-prime-minister-after-court-appeal-dismissed-2023-09-04/ (Reuters)]
